newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine T-bill yields: 3-mo down, 6-,9-,12-mo up.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine T-bill yields: 3-mo down, 6-,9-,12-mo up.

text.p: Average yields at auctions of three-month treasury bills slipped and six-month, nine-month, 12-month treasury bills edged up from the last sales, a central bank statement said on Thursday.

Three-month bills edged down to 24.43 percent from 24.47 percent, six-month bills edged up to 30.71 from 30.26 percent, nine-month bills edged up to 34.75 percent from 33.01 percent, and 12-month bills rose to 39.56 from 38.05 percent.
The results of Wednesday's three-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated no limit stated
Amount sold 1.16 million UAH 2.30 million UAH
Actual amount raised 1.09 million UAH 2.17 million UAH
The central bank sold 11,611 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 10,973 were competitive and 638 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 3.
The results of six-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated no limit stated
Amount sold 9.04 million UAH 10.59 million UAH
Actual amount raised 7.84 million UAH 9.20 million UAH
The central bank sold 90,438 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those 78,412 were competitive and 12,026 were non-competitive.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 3.
The results of nine-month discount T-bills auction, compared to last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated no limit stated
Amount sold 2.25 million UAH 1.27 million UAH
Actual amount raised 1.78 million UAH 1.02 million UAH
The central bank sold 22,500 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 3.
The results of the 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated no limit stated
Amount sold 27.81 million UAH 2.38 million UAH
Actual amount raised 19.94 million UAH 1.73 million UAH
The central bank sold 278,072 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 275,144 were competitive and 2,928 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 3.
